financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Underwritten public offering of ADSs led by Leerink Partners (priced Aug 1, 2025). Closing is inferred, not stated: the excerpts say the offering was priced and give no closing date.
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: We estimate that the net proceeds to us from this offering, after deducting the underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses payable by us, will be approximately $61.2 million.
